checkers.old_sampled: legacy sampled-thickness checker: printability._min_thickness n=600 seed=3 edge margin 0.8 mm on shape.tessellate(case tessellation); FAIL if p1 < 0.8 or NaN
checkers.v61_global: evaluate_thickness_v61 global_status (never PASS in this package)

interpretation.expected_v61: predeclared from the evaluator's documented rules before evaluation; not truth
interpretation.statistics: parametric fixture families are clustered and not IID; no IID confidence interval
interpretation.truth: closed-form construction dimensions; valid means no constructed wall below 0.8 mm in the fixture, not a universal minimum-wall proof
interpretation.truth_feature_local: whether the walls between a recognized hole feature and its non-entry faces are >= 0.8 mm; not_applicable when the fixture has no hole feature
interpretation.v6_non_geometry: the 100 V6 evidence/replay/production cases are re-run with their V6 checkers and are NOT_APPLICABLE to the V6.1 thickness evaluator

scoring.rules: PASS on valid = correct_accept; FAIL on invalid = correct_reject; PASS on invalid = false_accept; FAIL on valid = false_reject; UNKNOWN/missing/REJECTED = abstain; CRASH or harness execution error = crash

study: V6.1 E0 feature-local wall evaluator known answers
